title: New California Landlord Laws for 2027 Explained (Video)

findings.quote: with exceptions when there's no signal or a photo isn't safe
findings.root_cause: The revised article body distinguishes the two conditions correctly. The shared script and article tables still imply lack of signal excuses the photo. CCP §417.10(a)(1)(B), (a)(4).
findings.fix: Proof of service generally needs a photo with the date, time and location. If there’s no location signal, the server explains the missing stamp. If taking the photo would compromise safety, the server documents the attempt or service and explains why.

findings.root_cause: The video implies the baseline is always a pre-emergency amount. Penal Code §396(j)(11) includes a HUD-based baseline for units without recent rental activity. The article body correctly uses statutory baseline.
findings.fix: During a covered emergency, the law generally bars rent more than ten percent above the baseline set by law, which depends on the property’s rental history. Limited defenses apply.
